label: Basic
description: Basic spinner. Best for the bare default at its small native size, with no props and no text beside it.

label: In Buttons
description: Spinners in buttons. Best for leading spinners in a live primary, a disabled outline and a square icon only button with its own label.

label: In Badges
description: Spinners in badges. Best for status labels in primary, secondary and outline plus light destructive, success and info tints, each led by a spinner.

label: In Input Group
description: Spinner in input group. Best for a search field under a Searching label, its spinner shown in a leading addon before the typed text.

label: In Empty State
description: Spinner in empty state. Best for a centered loading view with the spinner in a muted tile, a Loading projects heading and a Cancel action.

label: Pending Buttons
description: Button loading states. Best for disabled default, outline and secondary buttons, each pairing a spinner with a pending word like Saving.

label: Overlay With Caption
description: Overlay loading spinner. Best for a translucent cover with a Refreshing data caption laid over a monthly report card's figures.

label: Full Page
description: Full screen loading state. Best for a standalone card with a faded spinner above a setup message and a smaller muted hint.

label: Inline Text
description: Inline loading text with spinner. Best for stacked status lines with 14px spinners, 2 tinted by the success and warning tokens for connected and reconnecting.

label: Loading Dots
description: Animated loading dots. Best for a row of 3 dots that bounce on staggered delays in the primary colour, with no icon.

label: Card Overlay
description: Spinner overlay on card. Best for a translucent cover holding only a spinner, inside the card it hides, with no caption.

label: Color Variants
description: Spinner colour variants. Best for a row of 5 small spinners tinted blue, green, red, yellow and violet through accent colour classes.
